root_run_budget_limits_check.name: root_run_budget_limits_check
root_run_budget_limits_check.value: "root_run_budget"."max_steps" > 0 AND "root_run_budget"."max_tokens" > 0 AND "root_run_budget"."max_duration_ms" > 0 AND "root_run_budget"."max_tool_calls" >= 0 AND "root_run_budget"."max_delegations" >= 0 AND "root_run_budget"."max_delegation_depth" >= 0 AND "root_run_budget"."max_parallel_children" >= 0 AND "root_run_budget"."max_sandbox_compute_ms" >= 0

root_run_budget_usage_check.name: root_run_budget_usage_check
root_run_budget_usage_check.value: "root_run_budget"."committed_steps" >= 0 AND "root_run_budget"."committed_tokens" >= 0 AND "root_run_budget"."committed_tool_calls" >= 0 AND "root_run_budget"."committed_delegations" >= 0 AND "root_run_budget"."committed_children" >= 0 AND "root_run_budget"."committed_sandbox_compute_ms" >= 0 AND "root_run_budget"."reserved_steps" >= 0 AND "root_run_budget"."reserved_tokens" >= 0 AND "root_run_budget"."reserved_tool_calls" >= 0 AND "root_run_budget"."reserved_delegations" >= 0 AND "root_run_budget"."reserved_children" >= 0 AND "root_run_budget"."reserved_sandbox_compute_ms" >= 0 AND "root_run_budget"."committed_steps" + "root_run_budget"."reserved_steps" <= "root_run_budget"."max_steps" AND "root_run_budget"."committed_tokens" + "root_run_budget"."reserved_tokens" <= "root_run_budget"."max_tokens" AND "root_run_budget"."committed_tool_calls" + "root_run_budget"."reserved_tool_calls" <= "root_run_budget"."max_tool_calls" AND "root_run_budget"."committed_delegations" + "root_run_budget"."reserved_delegations" <= "root_run_budget"."max_delegations" AND "root_run_budget"."reserved_children" <= "root_run_budget"."max_parallel_children" AND "root_run_budget"."committed_sandbox_compute_ms" + "root_run_budget"."reserved_sandbox_compute_ms" <= "root_run_budget"."max_sandbox_compute_ms"

sandbox_execution_compute_check.name: sandbox_execution_compute_check
sandbox_execution_compute_check.value: "sandbox_execution"."reserved_compute_ms" > 0 AND ("sandbox_execution"."duration_ms" IS NULL OR ("sandbox_execution"."duration_ms" >= 0 AND "sandbox_execution"."duration_ms" <= "sandbox_execution"."reserved_compute_ms")) AND ("sandbox_execution"."observed_wall_duration_ms" IS NULL OR "sandbox_execution"."observed_wall_duration_ms" >= 0)

sandbox_execution_terminal_check.name: sandbox_execution_terminal_check
sandbox_execution_terminal_check.value: ("sandbox_execution"."status" IN ('reserved', 'running') AND "sandbox_execution"."completed_at" IS NULL) OR ("sandbox_execution"."status" NOT IN ('reserved', 'running') AND "sandbox_execution"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)

sandbox_run_compute_budget_check.name: sandbox_run_compute_budget_check
sandbox_run_compute_budget_check.value: ("sandbox_run_compute_budget"."max_compute_ms" IS NULL OR "sandbox_run_compute_budget"."max_compute_ms" > 0) AND "sandbox_run_compute_budget"."reserved_compute_ms" >= 0 AND "sandbox_run_compute_budget"."committed_compute_ms" >= 0 AND ("sandbox_run_compute_budget"."max_compute_ms" IS NULL OR "sandbox_run_compute_budget"."reserved_compute_ms" + "sandbox_run_compute_budget"."committed_compute_ms" <= "sandbox_run_compute_budget"."max_compute_ms")

iris_task_terminal_timestamp_check.name: iris_task_terminal_timestamp_check
iris_task_terminal_timestamp_check.value: ("iris_task"."status" <> 'in_progress' OR "iris_task"."started_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("iris_task"."status" <> 'blocked' OR ("iris_task"."started_at" IS NOT NULL AND "iris_task"."blocked_at" IS NOT NULL)) AND ("iris_task"."status" <> 'completed' OR "iris_task"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("iris_task"."status" <> 'cancelled' OR "iris_task"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL)

user_memory_scope_check.name: user_memory_scope_check
